verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v1: yā man yanḥū ḥaqqā ʾamalu walaqad nufiyā l-mithlu l-mathalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v2: hadhā ʿabdu yarjū minanā wabihi ʾasafu yanmū wajalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v4: hadhā ʿabdu yashkū ʾarabā walakam quḍiyā l-mulhī sh-shughalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v5: farrij ʿannī ḍayqā ḥarajā walaqad marijat qalbī l-ʿilalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v6: jānā dahru hāla n-nubalā wabihi l-kuramā ghābū nfaṣalū
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v7: ʾanta l-ḥiṣnu l-wāqī karamā wabiḥurmahi man tuʿṭā l-milalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v8: famuḥammadunā huwa sayyidunā huwa ʾajmalu man tarnū l-muqalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v9: nūru l-khalqi l-musrā ʿalanā warawā ʿajabā ʾayna r-rusulu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v10: ḥālī rabbī lam yakhfa ʿalī wabiyā l-wahnu l-ʿajzu l-kasalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v11: fākshif ʿannī ḍurrā waʾasā wakadhā miḥanu ghammu ghilalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v12: sahil rabbī qaṣdā lijanā bika taqṣudukum ḥaqqā subulu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v13: ʾasbil sitrā faḍlā niʿmā walakum ghurafu maʿahā l-ḥulalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v14: ʾinnī ʾarjū mawtā karamā biṭarīqatinā niʿma l-ʿamalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v15: hiyā ʾuslūbu min dhī rutabi waliman dakhalū fawzu nafalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v16: ʾaʿnī shaykhā quṭbā wazarā waṣaḥābatuhu ḥaqqā waṣalū
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v17: ʾaʿnī shaykhā quṭbā wawirā thatuhu sabaqat sal man ʿaqalū
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v18: yā dhā l-bayti l-mabnī liṭawā ʾifihi khababu saʿyu ramalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v19: hadhā ʿabdu yaʾawī kanafā waḥawāʾijuhu shattā jumalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v20: ʿajjil ʿajjil ʾatmim gharaḍā liʿubaydika la rudda l-ʾamalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v21: ṣallā rabbī ʾazkā ṣ-ṣalawā ti ʿalā l-hādī fīhi l-ʾazalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v22: thumma l-ʾāli ṣ-ṣaḥbi l-kuramā wahumu l-ʿulamā kullu baṭalu
verses.famuhammaduna-huwa-sayyiduna-c1-v3: ʾanta llāhu l-mawlā l-karamu l-ʾaḥadu ṣ-ṣamadu l-fardu l-ʾawwalu
